title: triteleia ixioides var. scabra
intro: Triteleia ixioides var. scabra, commonly known as the rough-disk triteleia, is a flowering plant native to the western United States. The health benefits of Triteleia ixioides var. scabra include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in wound healing and the treatment of various infections. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to reduce inflammation and promote tissue repair, making it a potential treatment for skin conditions and other inflammatory disorders. The bioactive constituents of Triteleia ixioides var. scabra include saponins and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
